subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should configured `models.providers.*.models[*].input` keep audio/video as valid metadata, or should OpenClaw reject or gate those modalities until runtime support is explicit?
rationale: Current main intentionally accepts and preserves audio/video metadata, while the docs and media routing only define text/image semantics; changing this safely requires product/API intent, not a mechanical fix.

options.title: Preserve metadata, validate use
options.body: Keep audio/video in the model metadata contract, but add capability-specific guardrails so runtime paths reject or warn before using unsupported modalities.

options.title: Narrow to text/image
options.body: Reject audio/video in configured model inputs and update the type, schema, tests, docs, and generated-catalog handling to match the narrower runtime contract.

options.title: Add explicit override gate
options.body: Allow advanced operators to declare broader modalities only through a documented override/capability-source contract with clear diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Preserve metadata, validate use
recommendation.body: Keep audio/video in the model metadata contract, but add capability-specific guardrails so runtime paths reject or warn before using unsupported modalities.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged modality-widening commit is the clearest provenance for the current contract that maintainers need to confirm or revise.
